name: ADA4898-1 / ADA4898-2
tagline: 0.9 nV/√Hz, 55 V/µs bipolar op-amp for ±5 V to ±16 V rails; a diyAudio favourite for DAC I/V stages.

lineage.note: Sole source. Single launched May 2008; dual added Feb 2010. Fab Limerick (ADLK), plus Wilmington (ADWL) from 2023.

part_numbers.note: 8-lead SOIC_N_EP, RD-8-1 then RD-8-4 (Rev. F). -R7 = 7-inch reel. −40 to +105 °C.
8-lead SOIC_N_EP (RD-8-2). Production per ADI; DigiKey 2264650, Mouser. In PCN 22_0142.
7-inch reel of ADA4898-2YRDZ; listed at Octopart.

key_specs.value: 0.9 nV/√Hz typ (≈3.9 at 1 Hz, ≈2.8 at 2 Hz)

key_specs.condition: typ; ≈0.47 W for dual at ±15 V

reputation.summary: A niche part in DIY DAC circles. diyAudio builders pick it for I/V stages after current-output DACs, citing very low noise, bandwidth and ±16 V headroom. ADI pitches it for 16/18-bit systems. It also appears in instrument LNAs and photodetectors, such as Gerhard Hoffmann's 'lono' parallel LNA. An audio review site calls the ADA4898-1 a cheap LT1115 equivalent.
typical_uses: DAC output buffer or reconstruction filter
Low-noise LNA front ends, e.g. parallel arrays
caveats: SOIC-8 with exposed pad only; rolling needs an adapter. Tie the pad to −VS or leave floating, never ground/+VS.
About 7.9 mA per amplifier: a dual dissipates ≈0.47 W at ±15 V and runs warm on padless adapters.
Needs at least ±5 V; unsuitable for low-voltage portable designs.
High current noise (2.4 pA/√Hz); noise-optimal source impedance is about 375 Ω.
With 50–65 MHz bandwidth, layout, decoupling and capacitive loading matter; sockets can cause peaking or oscillation.

counterfeit_notes: No counterfeit or remarking reports found, though forums were not specifically checked. Cheap, SOIC-EP-only parts make poor fake targets. Pre-built DIP-8 adapters are unchecked. Buy from ADI-authorised distributors (DigiKey, Mouser); check for a real exposed pad and ADI marking.

silicon_changes.identification: No marking difference stated. Parts dated after mid-2023 may come from Limerick (ADLK) or Wilmington (ADWL); trace by ADI lot or date code.
silicon_changes.summary: PCN 22_0142 (Rev. -, 4 Apr 2023; later Revs. A and C) adds ADI Wilmington, MA (ADWL) as an alternate wafer fab to Limerick, Ireland (ADLK) for high-voltage bipolar products, for supply continuity. ADA4898-2YRDZ is listed; ADA4898-1 coverage is unconfirmed. No fit, form, function or reliability impact.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: None documented. Same process at a second fab; no data-sheet spec changed.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: same design and data sheet; only fab-to-fab variation
silicon_changes.verification: PCN scope and Revs. -, A and C confirmed. ADA4898-2 listing reported, full parts list not retrieved.

silicon_changes.identification: Data-sheet package code for the single changed RD-8-1 to RD-8-4. Compare exposed-pad dimensions in your revision's outline drawing.
silicon_changes.summary: The ADA4898-1 SOIC_N_EP outline was re-designated RD-8-1 to RD-8-4 with updated dimensions ('Changed RD-8-1 to RD-8-4 (Throughout)'). Not a die change; no PCN found. An earlier outline update was in Rev. D (5/12). Whether the physical pad changed is unconfirmed.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: None expected electrically; may affect footprint and thermal-pad matching only.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: documentation and outline change; check EP land pattern against current drawing
silicon_changes.verification: Rev. F history text and 01/19/2026 date confirmed; physical pad change unconfirmed.

refuted_claims: Current datasheet is not Rev. E: it is Rev. F (ADI-listed 01/19/2026).
Single and dual do not both use RD-8-2: the single was RD-8-1, now RD-8-4; RD-8-2 is the dual.
A process change is recorded: PCN 22_0142 (2023) added an alternate wafer fab for ADA4898-2.
A duplicate PCN 22_0142 entry was merged; its citation of unrelated PCN 10_0004 (halogen-free SOIC mold compound) was removed.
corrections: Current datasheet Rev. F (01/19/2026): RD-8-1 to RD-8-4, outline dimensions updated, ordering guide changed.
Launch date confirmed: Rev. 0 initial release 5/08.
ADA4898-2 added in Rev. C (2/10). Rev. D (5/12) changed Figure 2 caption and outline dimensions.
Added PCN 22_0142: ADWL alternate fab to ADLK; released 04-Apr-2023, effective 07-Jul-2023; no fit/form/function impact.
Added a package outline re-designation entry (ADA4898-1 RD-8-1 to RD-8-4).
Distortion: better than −90 dBc to 600 kHz, 2 V p-p, G=+1. GBW 50 MHz is separate from 65 MHz −3 dB bandwidth.
Supply current: 15.8 mA total for the dual (≈7.9 mA per amplifier).
Exposed pad may be tied to −VS or left floating.
